newsitem.title: JORDAN: Jordan shares slide again in bearish mood.
newsitem.headline: Jordan shares slide again in bearish mood.

text.p: The Amman bourse dropped again on Sunday in stagnant trade with minimal purchasing activity by investors depressing overall prices, brokers said.
The official 60-share Amman Financial Market (AFM) index slid another 0.21 percent to 150.00 points in poor turnover worth only 265,270 dinars ($374,675).
The bourse continued to falter for the seventh consecutive session to hover around it lowest levels since late November, which it reached again last week.
"There is no impetus to the market, there is a recession in activity... with irregular trades on some stock whose pattern is not repeating itself the next day," said broker Husam Hanbali.
The only performer, in otherwise weak trade across the board, was Jordan Cement Factory, which was unchanged at 3.78 dinars in the busiest stock traded on Sunday.
Its 76,369 dinars worth of business was at least double the more modest amounts in most of the active stock.
Arab Bank rose a marginal 0.500 dinar to 255.50 dinars in low turnover of 20,440 dinars.
Overall falling shares outnumbered gainers by 20 to 6, with another eleven closing unchanged.
